legend.0: compact: A local change: fix or implement one function or one small piece of logic in a single module, together with its tests. Roughly under 80 changed lines across at most three files, including tests. Adding a small helper or a few regression tests still counts. No new mechanism, no change other modules must adapt to.
legend.1: standard: A focused change that edits several functions or files, restructures a code path, or needs coordinated edits in more than one module, with tests, but introduces no new architecture.
legend.2: deep: A large or cross-cutting change: many files or subsystems, a new feature or mechanism, architecture or design work, public API, schema or storage-format changes, or data migration.
